summary: Correct the direction in the causative gloss
rationale: The entry defines slq as to go up, ascend. Stem III examples describe raising Farxo onto the throne, taking someone upstairs, and the bird carrying someone up to his homeland. The adjacent gloss nach oben bringen also confirms upward motion. Hinaussteigen introduces outward motion through an evident one-letter slip.

summary: Remove the stray ich from the clause about the bird
before: und nun will ich mich der Vogel
after: und nun will mich der Vogel
rationale: Der Vogel is the subject and mich the object. The extra ich makes the clause ungrammatical. The edition reads und nun will mich der Vogel nach meiner Heimat hinaufbringen.
